site.title: Jalaranu
site.description: Explore Jalaranu's underlake datacenter project, validation approach, and partnership opportunities for computing infrastructure in Indonesia.
site.footerTagline: Jalaranu - developing an underlake datacenter project to support Indonesia's digital resilience. The project evaluates thermal efficiency, operational reliability, and environmental effects through a staged, evidence-led program before any commitment to construction.
site.brandSlogan: Cold, silent, a sustainable data realm.

footer.privacyNote: The Privacy Notice will be updated to reflect actual data-handling practices.

about.seoDescription: Discover Jalaranu's identity, development principles, and the people responsible for its underlake datacenter project.

hero.h1: Rooted in Indonesian identity. Developed through evidence.
hero.body: Jalaranu is an initiative developing an underlake datacenter project. We aim to bring **engineering, infrastructure requirements, and an understanding of the environment** into a measurable development process.

body: The name Jalaranu combines “jala”, understood as water in the naming of this brand, and “ranu”, lake. Its visual identity draws inspiration from Javanese heritage.
A guardian goddess supports a datacenter beneath flowing water. The symbol expresses a responsibility to safeguard knowledge and the infrastructure that supports it.
That meaning carries into the way the project is developed: clear questions, focused testing, and honest communication about findings and limitations.

items.title: Responsibility across the facility's life
items.body: Planning covers installation, operation, recovery, and end of life.

items.title: Collaboration with clear roles
items.body: Contributions, interfaces, and responsibilities are agreed from the outset.

items.title: Proportionate openness
items.body: Public information explains the project rationale; detailed discussion follows need and access authority.
